 Irina Shayk’s Issey Miyake Corset Dress Barely Hangs on at WSJ Mag Awards
 Samridhi Goel 2026년 10월 30일 금 오전 6:51 UTC 0 Photo Credit: TheStewartofNY/WireImage via Getty Images Irina Shayk brings high-fashion drama and sculpted elegance to the 2026 WSJ. Magazine Innovator Awards. The supermodel steals the show in a futuristic white gown direct from the runway. She wears an architectural strapless Issey Miyake creation that redefines red-carpet style. Irina effortlessly proves that avant-garde corsetry, backless cuts, and clean minimalist lines create an unforgettable evening statement.
 Irina Shayk attends WSJ Magazine Innovator Awards in strapless Issey Miyake corset dress
 Irina models an all-white runway gown from Issey Miyake’s Fall/Winter 2026 Ready-To-Wear collection. The strapless dress features a structured, glossy patent-like corset bodice with a distinct rounded cup silhouette. Sculpted fabric panels flare out gently at the sides, while the completely backless cut plunges low to highlight her toned spine. The sleek column skirt flows gracefully to the floor with a subtle back slit, giving the futuristic silhouette an effortless sense of fluidity.
 Posing on the blue carpet, Irina turns her back to showcase the dramatic rear view of her strapless dress. She stands tall with her hands resting naturally at her sides, projecting pure high-fashion poise and total confidence. She skips all heavy jewelry, omitting necklaces and earrings to keep total focus on the architectural design of the dress.
 Advertisement
 Her dark hair is pulled back into a sleek, low chignon bun with a clean center part. Her glam team creates a fresh, natural makeup look featuring smooth glowing skin, soft bronzed cheeks, subtle eye shadow, and a matte nude lip.
 Irina masterfully combines Japanese runway innovation with high-impact supermodel confidence. By wearing a strapless, sculpted Issey Miyake gown for the star-studded awards night, she delivers a masterclass in modern red-carpet dressing. She carries the daring, structural dress with complete authority. Irina continues to solidify her place as a dominant global fashion force who commands every event she attends.
